title: Scammers have been tricking iPhone users into downloading apps that cost hundreds of dollars per year. Now, Apple appears to be cracking down (AAPL)
text: Scammers have been tricking iPhone users into downloading apps that cost hundreds of dollars per year. Now, Apple appears to be cracking down (AAPL) By Kif Leswing and Nick Bastone Oct 16, 2018, 4:56 pm 5 pts Some enterprising scammers have been tricking iPhone users into downloading apps that charge $4 per week or more — sometimes working out to hundreds of dollars per year. One of these apps even rose to No. 69 on Apple's top-grossing chart, suggesting that only 68 apps were making more money in…
